name: Deal Finder Ops
tagline: Checks a coupon against a real cart and shows you the receipt
description: Verifies a coupon by running it against a real cart instead of trusting the number in the advert. Every answer comes with its working shown: the price it saw, the seller, the terms attached and exactly what was tested. A saving is only claimed when the evidence backs it.
author: thewyattbrocato
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
